launch_lessons.failure: The jobs CLI parsed bash -lc as its own options, so bash received the command text as a filename and exited 127.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Place an explicit -- argument separator before the image and container command.

launch_lessons.failure: The Hugging Face downloader encountered a non-UTF-8 charmap while emitting progress output and exited before training.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Set PYTHONUTF8=1, LANG=C.UTF-8, LC_ALL=C.UTF-8, and HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 before any Hugging Face CLI command.

launch_lessons.failure: The jobs log transport still exposed a legacy charmap, and the Hugging Face CLI emitted a Unicode completion checkmark despite UTF-8 and disabled progress bars.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Do not use the Hugging Face CLI for checkpoint retrieval in jobs. Download the immutable artifact with authenticated retrying curl and verify its expected SHA-256 before extraction.

launch_lessons.failure: The pinned training image does not contain curl, so the CLI-free HTTP download exited 127.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Use the repository-owned scripts/download_checkpoint.py helper built on locked httpx; it provides authenticated retries, ASCII-only output, atomic replacement, and SHA-256 verification without external download executables.

launch_lessons.failure: The downloader correctly rejected the archive because the launch supplied checkpoint_sha256, the extracted checkpoint content digest, instead of artifact_sha256, the archive file digest.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Track checkpoint_sha256 and artifact_sha256 as distinct provenance fields. Verify downloads against checkpoint.json artifact_sha256 and the matching Hugging Face LFS SHA-256.

launch_lessons.failure: Brax initial evaluation traced the Stage-II reward and found stagnation referenced forward_velocity before its local assignment, raising UnboundLocalError before the first optimizer step.
launch_lessons.mitigation: Compute terrain-frame forward and lateral velocity before all time-bound locomotion rewards, and trace a real Stage-II reset/step in the environment contract tests.

monitoring_lessons.observation: The local Windows hf jobs logs client can fail to encode Unicode progress bars even while the remote job remains healthy.
monitoring_lessons.practice: Set local PYTHONUTF8=1 when reading logs and use the authoritative job status before classifying or relaunching a run. Never treat an observer-side rendering error as a workload failure.
